summary: Iteration 106: Complete testing of Parceiros (Partners) feature - Admin CRUD panel and public athlete view. All 11 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend features verified.

Backend: Image upload stores files in /app/uploads/parceiros/ with correct URL prefix /api/uploads/parceiros/
Backend: Excel export returns valid XLSX with proper headers and data
Backend: Public endpoint /api/parceiros returns only active parceiros (ativo=True)
Frontend (DashboardParceiros.jsx): Form has all required fields - Nome, Instagram, Site, Image upload with 1:1 crop
Frontend: ImageCropModal integration working for square image cropping
Frontend: Grid displays parceiros with images, edit/delete buttons, and social links
Frontend: Export Excel button opens download with token in query param
Frontend (ParceirosPage.jsx): Public page accessible at /parceiros without auth
Frontend: Grid with parceiro cards showing images and clickable Instagram/Site links with icons
Frontend (RankingPage.js): 'Parceiros' button with Handshake icon visible in navigation bar
seed_data_creation: Existing parceiro 'Nike Running' in DB. Test parceiros created and cleaned up after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 106 validated Parceiros feature: (1) Admin panel at /admin with 'Parceiros' tab in sidebar under GESTÃO section, (2) DashboardParceiros component with CRUD operations - create/edit/delete parceiros, (3) Form modal with Nome, Instagram, Site fields and ImageCropModal for 1:1 square image upload, (4) Export Excel button working with token auth, (5) Public page at /parceiros accessible without login, (6) White background, grid layout with parceiro cards, (7) Instagram and Site links with icons (Instagram=purple, Site=blue), (8) 'Parceiros' button in main page navigation bar navigates to /parceiros.
